wake1: A scream. Muffled. It woke Elisa up.
wake2a: Ok so. A scream, muffled, woke Elisa up.
wake2c: Again. A scream. Again, Elisa woke up.
wake2d: Back in bed. As if nothing happened. Lucky girl.
nudge_b: The bed won't climb out of itself.
paralysis: Paralyzed, she felt a presence crawling on her bed from the darkness. Slowly, the cold hand wrapped her fingers around her neck, and...
getup: She climbed out of bed, with the urge to see where it came from.
wait: Determined to find her parents, she... wait.
wardrobe: The wardrobe door opened. By itself. Naturally.
eyes_wardrobe: Something in the wardrobe was looking at Elisa. Not to look back would be wise.
eyes_bed: Then, under the bed. Two eyes. Patient ones.
scan_a: In the cold, she looked around her room, searching for something useful.
scan_b: Looking is free. Walking, apparently, costs extra.
scan_c: Elisa's eyes wandered. Her feet did not.
idle_a: Elisa stood perfectly still, waiting, perhaps, for the dark to get bored.
idle_b: Elisa waited. The dark waited too. It's better at it.
bed: Elisa considered going back to bed. A tempting idea. Also a cowardly one.
drawer: The girl checked the desk drawer.
flashlight: Ah, a flashlight... Elisa had a luminous idea. But...
nobatt: It did not turn on. Of course it didn't. Nothing is ever that easy.
dolls: The dolls on the shelf watched Elisa. They always did.
chest: The toy chest. Full of old friends. Most of them ... harmless.
window: Outside, the garden. And the doghouse. Whatever had been chained there was no longer... chained there.
drawing: A drawing. Elisa didn't remember drawing it. That was the interesting part.
bunny: Bunny was asleep. Bunny was always asleep when Elisa needed him.
again_a: Elisa looked again. Nothing had changed. Things rarely do.
again_c: Elisa checked again. Thorough. Or stalling.
batt1: One battery. Elisa needed two. Mathematics can be so cruel.
batt2: And the second battery. Light, at last.
coats: Coats. Just coats. How very disappointing for everyone.
toys: Toys. Only toys. Elisa almost sounded relieved.
unreachable_a: Elisa could not reach that. Elisa is small. We've been over this.
unreachable_b: Too far, Elisa. Walk first. Then touch.
hall_dark: Elisa stepped into the dark hallway without a light. Bold. Foolish, but bold.
hall_lamp: Flashlight in hand, Elisa stepped into the hallway. And the story could finally begin.
death1: Ouch. That did not seem pleasant.
death2: Well. Elisa did not think things through.
death_end: That, I'm afraid, was the end of Elisa. For tonight.
death_wardrobe: Never open a wardrobe that opens itself. Elementary.
death_bed: Looking under the bed. In the dark. A classic, at least.
death_dark: The dark hallway. Without a light. Elisa was brave. Briefly.
death_paralysis: Elisa did not move. The night moved for her.
threshold: The dark, beyond the threshold of the bedroom door, gave the girl goosebumps.
door_no: I would not open that door. But then... who am I, really?
